features.requirement: horizontal dark stripes along silver flanks
features.observed: Silver flanks carry distinct horizontal dark stripes; deeply forked red-tinged tail and reddish fins, with large visible interlocking dagger fangs at the nearly closed mouth. Complete caudal stalk and adipose fin visible. Fangs are strongly exaggerated and lower forward fin placement needs anatomy review; narrow left margin.
